title: 1 Samuel Chapter 10 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on 1 Samuel chapter 10 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: 1 Samuel Chapter 10 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of 1 Samuel Chapter 10.

questions.question: What did Samuel pour upon Saul's head to anoint him?
questions.correctAnswer: Oil
questions.explanation: Samuel took a vial of oil and poured it upon Saul's head to anoint him, as stated in 1 Samuel 10:1.

questions.question: Where did Saul find the two men who told him the asses were found?
questions.correctAnswer: By Rachel's sepulchre
questions.explanation: Saul was told he would find two men by Rachel's sepulchre in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah, as described in 1 Samuel 10:2.

questions.question: What were the three men going up to God to Bethel carrying?
options: Three kids, three loaves of bread, and a bottle of wine
Three lambs, three baskets of bread, and a jug of water
Three oxen, three loaves of bread, and a bottle of oil
Three goats, three loaves of bread, and a bottle of milk
questions.correctAnswer: Three kids, three loaves of bread, and a bottle of wine
questions.explanation: The three men were carrying three kids, three loaves of bread, and a bottle of wine, as stated in 1 Samuel 10:3.

questions.question: What did the three men give Saul when they met him going to Bethel?
questions.correctAnswer: Two loaves of bread
questions.explanation: The men greeted Saul and gave him two loaves of bread, which he was to receive, as described in 1 Samuel 10:4.

questions.question: What musical instruments did the company of prophets carry when Saul met them?
questions.correctAnswer: Psaltery, tabret, pipe, and harp
questions.explanation: The prophets were coming down with a psaltery, tabret, pipe, and harp, as noted in 1 Samuel 10:5.

questions.question: What happened to Saul when the Spirit of the LORD came upon him?
options: He prophesied and was turned into another man
He ran away from the prophets
He was struck down with illness
questions.correctAnswer: He prophesied and was turned into another man
questions.explanation: The Spirit of the LORD came upon Saul, and he prophesied with the prophets and became another man, as described in 1 Samuel 10:6.

questions.question: What was Saul instructed to do when the signs came unto him?
options: Do as occasion serve thee; for God is with thee
Offer sacrifices on the hill of God
questions.correctAnswer: Do as occasion serve thee; for God is with thee
questions.explanation: Samuel instructed Saul to act as the occasion served him because God was with him, according to 1 Samuel 10:7.

questions.question: Where was Saul told to go and wait for Samuel to come and show him what to do?
questions.correctAnswer: Gilgal
questions.explanation: Saul was told to go down to Gilgal and wait seven days for Samuel to come and instruct him, as stated in 1 Samuel 10:8.

questions.question: What change did God give Saul when he turned his back to go from Samuel?
questions.correctAnswer: Another heart
questions.explanation: God gave Saul another heart when he turned his back to leave Samuel, as described in 1 Samuel 10:9.

questions.question: True or False: Saul prophesied among the prophets when he met them on the hill.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: When Saul met the prophets on the hill, the Spirit of God came upon him and he prophesied among them, as recorded in 1 Samuel 10:10.

questions.question: True or False: Samuel told Saul that his father was happy about the lost asses.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Samuel said Saul's father sorrowed for the lost asses, not that he was happy, as shown in 1 Samuel 10:2.

questions.question: True or False: Samuel kissed Saul after anointing him.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Samuel kissed Saul after pouring oil on his head to anoint him, as described in 1 Samuel 10:1.

questions.question: True or False: Saul was told to immediately confront the Philistines after meeting the prophets.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Saul was instructed to go to Gilgal and wait seven days for Samuel, not to confront the Philistines immediately, as stated in 1 Samuel 10:8.

questions.question: In 1 Samuel 10, which event comes first?
options: Saul met the company of prophets
Saul went to Gilgal to wait for Samuel
Saul found the two men by Rachel's sepulchre
questions.correctAnswer: Samuel anointed Saul with oil
questions.explanation: The first event is Samuel anointing Saul with oil, followed by Saul meeting the two men, then the prophets, and then going to Gilgal, as narrated starting in 1 Samuel 10:1.

questions.question: What did the men by Rachel's sepulchre tell Saul about the asses?
options: The asses which thou wentest to seek are found
The asses are stolen by Philistines
The asses are resting in the field
questions.correctAnswer: The asses which thou wentest to seek are found
questions.explanation: The men said the asses which Saul went to seek were found, as recorded in 1 Samuel 10:2.

medium.title: 1 Samuel Chapter 10 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from 1 Samuel Chapter 10 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What happened to Saul when he turned his back to leave Samuel?
options: He was rejected by the people
He lost the Spirit of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: God gave him another heart
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:9 states that when Saul turned to leave Samuel, God gave him another heart, signifying a transformation in his inner being.

questions.question: What was the reaction of those who knew Saul when they saw him prophesying among the prophets?
options: They were amazed and asked if Saul was also among the prophets
They ignored him and walked away
questions.correctAnswer: They were amazed and asked if Saul was also among the prophets
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:11 explains that those who knew Saul before were surprised to see him prophesying and questioned, 'Is Saul also among the prophets?'.

questions.question: How does 1 Samuel 10:17-18 teach us about God's faithfulness amidst human rejection?
options: God reminds Israel of His deliverance despite their rejection
God abandons Israel when they reject Him
God punishes Israel immediately for their sins
God allows enemies to conquer Israel
questions.correctAnswer: God reminds Israel of His deliverance despite their rejection
questions.explanation: Verses 17 and 18 show Samuel calling the people and reminding them that God brought Israel out of Egypt and delivered them from oppression, highlighting God's enduring faithfulness even though Israel had rejected Him.

questions.question: What instruction did Samuel give the people after anointing Saul king?
options: He told them the manner of the kingdom and wrote it in a book
He commanded them to build a temple immediately
He instructed them to go to war the next day
He told them to ignore Saul
questions.correctAnswer: He told them the manner of the kingdom and wrote it in a book
questions.explanation: According to 1 Samuel 10:25, Samuel informed the people about the way the kingdom would be governed and recorded it before the LORD, demonstrating the importance of understanding and obedience to God's order.

questions.question: What did Saul’s uncle ask him after Saul returned from seeking the asses?
questions.correctAnswer: Where did you go?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:14 shows Saul's uncle asking him and his servant where they had gone, to which Saul answered that they went to seek the asses but eventually came to Samuel.

questions.question: True or False: Saul told his uncle everything Samuel said about the kingdom.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:16 indicates Saul told his uncle only about the asses being found, but did not reveal what Samuel said about the kingdom.

questions.question: Where did Samuel gather the people to present Saul as king?
questions.correctAnswer: Mizpeh
questions.explanation: In 1 Samuel 10:17, Samuel called the people together unto the LORD at Mizpeh to present Saul as the chosen king.

questions.question: What does 1 Samuel 10:22 reveal about Saul’s initial reaction when he was sought among the people?
options: He hid himself among the stuff
He immediately stood before the crowd
He was crowned on the spot
questions.correctAnswer: He hid himself among the stuff
questions.explanation: Verse 22 shows that Saul was not immediately found because he hid himself among the stuff, demonstrating humility or fear.

questions.question: How does the people's shout in 1 Samuel 10:24 demonstrate their acceptance of Saul?
questions.correctAnswer: They shouted, "God save the king!"
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:24 records the people shouting 'God save the king!' showing their acknowledgment and acceptance of Saul as chosen by the LORD.

questions.question: What does the presence of a band of men with Saul indicate about his leadership according to 1 Samuel 10:26?
options: They were soldiers sent to capture him
They were enemies plotting against him
questions.correctAnswer: Their hearts God had touched
questions.explanation: Verse 26 states that Saul went home with a band of men whose hearts God had touched, indicating divine favor on his leadership.

questions.question: What was the attitude of the children of Belial toward Saul, as described in 1 Samuel 10:27?
options: They despised him and brought him no presents
They sought to crown him king
questions.correctAnswer: They despised him and brought him no presents
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:27 shows that wicked people despised Saul and did not honor him, demonstrating opposition despite his anointing.

questions.question: True or False: The Spirit of the LORD came upon Saul and he prophesied with the company of prophets.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:10 confirms that when Saul met the prophets, the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he prophesied among them.

questions.question: What does 1 Samuel 10:6 teach about the transformation that occurs when the Spirit of the LORD comes upon a person?
options: The person is turned into another man
The person is rejected by others
questions.correctAnswer: The person is turned into another man
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says that when the Spirit of the LORD comes upon Saul, he prophesies and is turned into another man, highlighting spiritual transformation.

questions.question: What does 1 Samuel 10:7 indicate is the reason for Saul to act upon the signs he will see?
questions.correctAnswer: Because God is with him
questions.explanation: Verse 7 instructs Saul to do as the occasion serves when the signs come, for God is with him, emphasizing trust in divine guidance.

questions.question: True or False: In 1 Samuel 10, Samuel promised to come to Saul at Gilgal to offer sacrifices and show him what to do.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:8 clearly states that Samuel told Saul to go to Gilgal where he would come to offer burnt offerings and sacrifices and instruct him further.

hard.title: 1 Samuel Chapter 10 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from 1 Samuel Chapter 10.

questions.question: According to 1 Samuel 10, what did Samuel do after anointing Saul with oil?
options: He kissed him and declared him captain over God's inheritance
He sent him to battle with the Philistines
He told him to leave and never return
questions.correctAnswer: He kissed him and declared him captain over God's inheritance
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:1 states that Samuel took a vial of oil, poured it on Saul's head, kissed him, and said that the LORD had anointed him to be captain over His inheritance.

questions.question: What did Saul find by Rachel's sepulchre as Samuel had foretold?
options: Two men who told him the asses were found
Samuel waiting to anoint him king
questions.correctAnswer: Two men who told him the asses were found
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:2 records that Saul found two men by Rachel's sepulchre who told him the asses he sought were found and that his father was sorrowing over him.

questions.question: What did Saul receive from the three men going up to God at Bethel?
questions.correctAnswer: Two loaves of bread
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:4 states that the three men going up to God saluted Saul and gave him two loaves of bread, which he received from their hands.

questions.question: What was the reaction of those who knew Saul when they saw him prophesying with the prophets?
options: They questioned if Saul was also among the prophets
questions.correctAnswer: They questioned if Saul was also among the prophets
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:11 describes that those who knew Saul were amazed and asked, 'Is Saul also among the prophets?' when they saw him prophesying.

questions.question: What did Saul's uncle ask him upon seeing him after the meeting with Samuel?
questions.correctAnswer: Where had he gone?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:14 records that Saul's uncle asked him and his servant where they had gone, and Saul replied that they had gone to seek the asses, then came to Samuel.

questions.question: Why did the people of Israel request a king according to Samuel's message at Mizpeh?
options: Because they had rejected God who saved them from adversities
Because they wanted to conquer new lands
Because Saul was the strongest man
questions.correctAnswer: Because they had rejected God who saved them from adversities
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:19 explains that the people rejected God who saved them and said, 'Nay, but set a king over us.'

questions.question: Which tribe was chosen by lot when Samuel gathered all Israel to find the king?
questions.correctAnswer: Benjamin
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:20 states that when all the tribes were gathered, the tribe of Benjamin was taken by lot.

questions.question: Where did Saul hide when the people sought him to present him as king?
questions.correctAnswer: Among the stuff
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:22 recounts that the LORD said Saul had hid himself among the stuff, and the people fetched him from there.

questions.question: What notable physical characteristic did Saul have when he stood among the people?
options: He was taller than any of the people from his shoulders and upward
He had a scar on his face
He wore a crown of gold
He was dressed in royal robes
questions.correctAnswer: He was taller than any of the people from his shoulders and upward
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:23 describes Saul as being taller than any of the people from his shoulders upward when he stood among them.

questions.question: What did the people shout when Samuel showed them Saul as the LORD's chosen king?
questions.correctAnswer: God save the king
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:24 records that all the people shouted, 'God save the king' when Samuel presented Saul as chosen by the LORD.

questions.question: What did Samuel do after presenting Saul as king before the LORD?
options: He told the people the manner of the kingdom and wrote it in a book
He led the people in battle
He anointed Saul with more oil
questions.correctAnswer: He told the people the manner of the kingdom and wrote it in a book
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:25 states that Samuel explained the kingdom's manner, wrote it in a book, and laid it up before the LORD.

questions.question: Who went with Saul to Gibeah after he became king?
options: A band of men whose hearts God had touched
questions.correctAnswer: A band of men whose hearts God had touched
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:26 records that Saul went home to Gibeah accompanied by men whose hearts God had touched.

questions.question: How did the children of Belial respond to Saul's kingship?
options: They despised him and brought him no presents
questions.correctAnswer: They despised him and brought him no presents
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:27 explains that the children of Belial despised Saul, doubted his ability to save them, and brought him no presents.

questions.question: True or False: Samuel told the people that God Himself had saved them from all their adversities and yet they requested a king to rule over them.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:18-19 clearly states that God brought Israel out of Egypt and saved them from adversities, but the people rejected God by demanding a king.

questions.question: True or False: Saul was immediately found when Samuel called the tribe of Benjamin and was presented without any difficulty.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:21-22 shows that Saul could not be found initially, and the LORD had to reveal that he was hiding among the stuff before he was brought out.

theological.title: 1 Samuel Chapter 10 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from 1 Samuel Chapter 10 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What was the significance of Samuel pouring oil upon Saul's head and anointing him?
options: It symbolized Saul's appointment as captain over God's inheritance
It was a ritual for cleansing from sin
It was a traditional greeting among the Israelites
It was a sign of Saul's wealth and status
questions.correctAnswer: It symbolized Saul's appointment as captain over God's inheritance
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:1 explicitly states that Samuel anointed Saul, indicating his divine appointment as leader over God's inheritance, signifying God's chosen leadership.

questions.question: According to 1 Samuel 10, what did God give Saul when he turned to go from Samuel?
questions.correctAnswer: Another heart
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:9 says God gave Saul another heart, indicating a transformation in his inner being necessary for his new role as king.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is demonstrated by the Spirit of the LORD coming upon Saul and enabling him to prophesy?
questions.correctAnswer: God's empowering presence
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:6 shows the Spirit of the LORD empowering Saul to prophesy and become another man, demonstrating God's active empowerment of His chosen servant.

questions.question: How does the chapter illustrate the concept of God's sovereignty in choosing a king?
options: God directs the selection of Saul through signs and the casting of lots
The people elect Saul through a popular vote
Saul seizes the throne by force
Samuel appoints Saul without God's input
questions.correctAnswer: God directs the selection of Saul through signs and the casting of lots
questions.explanation: Verses 17-23 describe Samuel calling the tribes and families, and God directing the choice of Saul, who was hidden and then revealed, affirming God's sovereignty in leadership selection.

questions.question: What does 1 Samuel 10:18 reveal about God's historical relationship with Israel?
options: God delivered Israel from Egypt and from all kingdoms that oppressed them
God abandoned Israel to their enemies
Israel conquered Egypt by their own strength
questions.correctAnswer: God delivered Israel from Egypt and from all kingdoms that oppressed them
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:18 recounts God's saving acts in Israel's history, emphasizing His faithfulness and power in delivering His people from oppression.

questions.question: What doctrinal truth is taught by Samuel’s statement in 1 Samuel 10:19 about Israel rejecting God and asking for a king?
options: Human rejection of divine kingship leads to the demand for human kings
Israel was content under God's direct rule
God desired Israel to have multiple kings
The people preferred divine rule over human rule
questions.correctAnswer: Human rejection of divine kingship leads to the demand for human kings
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:19 teaches the doctrine of human sinfulness in rejecting God's direct rule in favor of human leadership, highlighting the tension between divine sovereignty and human agency.

questions.question: How does 1 Samuel 10:10-11 contribute to the biblical theology of prophetic empowerment?
options: Saul prophesying among prophets shows God’s Spirit enabling unexpected persons
Prophecy is limited to the elders
Saul’s prophecy was a sign of rebellion
questions.correctAnswer: Saul prophesying among prophets shows God’s Spirit enabling unexpected persons
questions.explanation: Verses 10-11 depict Saul, previously not recognized as a prophet, empowered by God’s Spirit to prophesy, indicating God’s sovereign choice to raise leaders by His Spirit.

questions.question: What theological insight emerges when combining 1 Samuel 10:5-6 and 1 Samuel 10:11 regarding the Spirit’s work in Saul?
options: The Spirit transforms and empowers Saul to fulfill God’s purpose despite initial doubt
The Spirit condemns Saul for his failures
The Spirit only works after Saul’s coronation
questions.correctAnswer: The Spirit transforms and empowers Saul to fulfill God’s purpose despite initial doubt
questions.explanation: Verses 5-6 show the Spirit coming upon Saul causing a transformation; verse 11 shows people surprised by his prophetic ability, revealing the Spirit's empowering role overcoming human limitations.

questions.question: What does the narrative in 1 Samuel 10:21-23 teach about God’s providence in leadership selection?
options: God orchestrates circumstances to reveal His chosen leader at the right time
Leaders emerge by human effort alone
Saul was immediately found without any divine involvement
Leadership is decided by popular acclaim only
questions.correctAnswer: God orchestrates circumstances to reveal His chosen leader at the right time
questions.explanation: Verses 21-23 describe Saul hiding among the stuff and God revealing him at the proper moment, illustrating divine providence in leadership.

questions.question: What combined teaching about divine-human interaction can be drawn from 1 Samuel 10:7 and 1 Samuel 10:26?
options: God's presence with Saul changes men's hearts and draws followers
Saul's success depends solely on his own strength
God abandons Saul after his anointing
questions.correctAnswer: God's presence with Saul changes men's hearts and draws followers
questions.explanation: Verse 7 encourages Saul to act with God’s presence, and verse 26 notes men whose hearts God touched followed Saul, showing divine initiative in human allegiance.

questions.question: How does 1 Samuel 10:24 reflect the doctrine of divine election in Israel’s monarchy?
options: God chooses a king unique among the people
The people choose their king arbitrarily
Kingship is based on military strength
The oldest son inherits the throne
questions.correctAnswer: God chooses a king unique among the people
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:24 shows Samuel declaring Saul as the LORD's chosen, emphasizing divine election rather than human merit or inheritance.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that 1 Samuel 10 portrays Saul’s kingship as a human political invention rather than divine appointment. What does 1 Samuel 10:1-7 actually teach about Saul’s kingship?
options: Saul’s kingship is divinely ordained through anointing and the Spirit’s empowerment
Saul was chosen by popular demand without God’s involvement
Saul usurped the throne by force
questions.correctAnswer: Saul’s kingship is divinely ordained through anointing and the Spirit’s empowerment
questions.explanation: Verses 1-7 describe Samuel anointing Saul and the Spirit of the LORD empowering him, affirming divine appointment over human invention (cf. Psalm 2:6; Isaiah 45:1).

questions.question: What does 1 Samuel 10:27 reveal about human response to God's anointed leaders and the nature of spiritual opposition?
options: Belial’s children despised Saul and rejected him despite God’s touch on his followers
Saul was universally supported with gifts
Spiritual opposition is irrelevant to leadership
questions.correctAnswer: Belial’s children despised Saul and rejected him despite God’s touch on his followers
questions.explanation: Verse 27 shows that despite God touching some hearts to follow Saul, others opposed and despised him, illustrating spiritual opposition to God’s purposes.

questions.question: What theological insight is evident when synthesizing 1 Samuel 10:2-4 and 1 Samuel 10:8 about God’s providential guidance and the role of ritual in Saul’s commissioning?
options: God provides signs for guidance and establishes ritual offerings to confirm Saul’s kingship
Saul acts independently without divine direction
God’s guidance is ambiguous and unclear
questions.correctAnswer: God provides signs for guidance and establishes ritual offerings to confirm Saul’s kingship
questions.explanation: Verses 2-4 describe signs God provides Saul for confirmation; verse 8 details Samuel’s offering sacrifices at Gilgal, combining providence and ritual in commissioning.

questions.question: Which doctrine is illustrated by Samuel writing down the manner of the kingdom and laying it before the LORD in 1 Samuel 10:25?
options: The doctrine of covenant faithfulness and accountability
The doctrine of kingship by inheritance
questions.correctAnswer: The doctrine of covenant faithfulness and accountability
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:25 shows Samuel documenting the kingdom’s regulations and placing them before the LORD, indicating accountability to God’s covenantal standards.
